##### **STEPHANIE BYWATER**

CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER

Stephanie has worked in compliance since 2005 and has extensive experience developing and managing
programs to support compliance with global, federal, and state laws and regulations in the
healthcare and biotech industries. Prior to joining Agendia, Stephanie spent a significant portion
of her career serving as a compliance officer in laboratories, such as HealthTrackRx, NeoGenomics,
and Myriad Genetics, and held compliance leadership roles in medical device, pharma, and large
health systems.

Stephanie graduated Summa Cum Laude with a B.S. in Healthcare Administration from Northern Illinois
University and is Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC), Data Privacy (CHP), Research Compliance
(CHRC), and is a Certified Internal Auditor (CIA).

##### **STEPHANIE BYWATER**

CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER

Stephanie has worked in compliance since 2005 and has extensive experience developing and managing
programs to support compliance with global, federal, and state laws and regulations in the
healthcare and biotech industries. Prior to joining Agendia, Stephanie spent a significant portion
of her career serving as a compliance officer in laboratories, such as HealthTrackRx, NeoGenomics,
and Myriad Genetics, and held compliance leadership roles in medical device, pharma, and large
health systems.

Stephanie graduated Summa Cum Laude with a B.S. in Healthcare Administration from Northern Illinois
University and is Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC), Data Privacy (CHP), Research Compliance
(CHRC), and is a Certified Internal Auditor (CIA).

and services that accelerate work and amplify impact for a healthier, safer, and more sustainable

Offices in 35 countries.

## People power progress.

We believe great ideas can come from anywhere – because our customers rely on the ingenuity,

We’re on a mission to transform our world. Will you join us?

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

### Featured Products - See our favorites

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

sequencing order.

[View our Events Schedule][107]
ACGT is now in the San Francisco Bay Area
ACGT has opened a new lab in the San Francisco Bay Area. Contact us to request a dropbox.
[Request a Dropbox][108]
Welcome to ACGT
As a provider of DNA sequencing and molecular biology services since 1993, ACGT understands your
needs. Our expert staff will provide you with the highest quality customer service and research
execution.
$50 Reward Bonus with the ACGT Card
Earn an extra $50 in credit for every ACGT Card purchase or refill of $500 or more.
[Sign In To Purchase a Card][109]
Partnering with Sequencing Cores
For our very best rates and fastest turnaround times consider a dedicated partnership for all your
sequencing needs.
[Learn More][110]
Unlock Precision with SNP Genotyping
Discover the power of accurate genotyping with ACGT’s state-of-the-art technologies, including NGS,
Sanger sequencing, TaqMan genotyping, and custom-designed assays. Whether your focus is on
personalized medicine or evolutionary studies, our expert team ensures high throughput and
unparalleled quality in every project.
[Start Your Order][111]

Sequence entire plasmids with
Oxford Nanopore long-read technology.

About BIO

The Biotechnology Innovation Organization (BIO) is the premier biotechnology advocacy organization
representing biotech companies, industry leaders, and state biotech associations in the United
States and more than 35 countries around the globe. BIO members range from biotech start-ups to some
of the world’s largest biopharmaceutical companies – all united by the same goal: to develop medical
and scientific breakthroughs that prevent and fight disease, restore health, and improve patients’
lives. BIO also organizes the BIO International Convention and a series of annual conferences that
drive partnerships, investment, and progress within the sector.

representing biotech companies, industry leaders, and state biotech associations in the United
States and more than 35 countries around the globe. BIO members range from biotech start-ups to some

Biomarker Technologies is dedicated to advancing genetic innovation that transforms industries and elevates human welfare. Through cutting-edge biotechnology solutions, we strive to pioneer sustainable progress while maintaining an unwavering commitment to creating exceptional value for our partners. Our vision extends beyond commercial success – we aim to establish a global innovation hub that redefines standards in the bio-industry and leaves an enduring legacy of scientific advancement. With a proven track record of innovation, the team has published hundreds of high-impact studies in leading journals such as Nature, Nature Genetics, Plant Cell, and Nature Communications. Additionally, we hold 60+ national invention patents and 200+ software copyrights, reflecting our commitment to advancing technology and intellectual leadership. BOLDv5 features a completely redesigned layout compared to BOLDv4, with a focus on richer content
and supporting materials. It also includes a more complex site structure. Tutorials are being

###### Overview

## Process of identifying species via standardized DNA genetic markers.

##### **01.**
##### DNA Extraction:

The process begins with isolating DNA from the specimen. This step requires care to ensure that the
genetic material is free from contaminants and adequately preserved for subsequent analysis.

##### **02.**
##### PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction):

Using the extracted DNA, the PCR amplifies target gene regions, creating numerous copies to
facilitate detailed examination. This step is crucial for enhancing the visibility of genetic
markers necessary for identification.

##### **03.**
##### Sequencing:

The amplified DNA undergoes sequencing, where the order of nucleotides is determined. This sequence
represents the unique fingerprint of the species and is essential for accurate identification.

##### **04.**
##### Sequence Matching:

Finally, the obtained sequence is matched against reference libraries in BOLD. This comparison
allows for the identification of the specimen by finding the closest records.

### Through this method, unknown samples are identified to species present in the reference library.

[ Identify Now ][28]

###### Data

## Barcode Index Numbers (BINs)

The Barcode Index Number (BIN) system is an automated method for clustering DNA barcode sequences
from animals into operational taxonomic units that usually correspond to species. Each cluster is
assigned a unique identifier which serves as a proxy for a species, enabling researchers to examine
biodiversity patterns even in the absence of formal species descriptions.

By standardizing DNA-based species identification, the BIN system facilitates large-scale
biodiversity assessments, supports species discovery, and enhances ecological and conservation
efforts.

Each BIN is linked to a dedicated page that consolidates all available data for its members.

[ BIN Database ][29]

###### Data Dissemination

## Our Database Partners

Working with major biodiversity databasing initiatives, BOLD ensures interoperability and maximizes
access to DNA barcode data.

###### Timeline

## The History of BOLD

BOLD started as a database and analytical platform but has since expanded its role. With its rapidly
growing database, broad taxonomic coverage, and novel methods and functionalities, it has become a
key component of the biodiversity informatics landscape.

### Proof-of-concept

**BOLD** was launched as a proof-of-concept platform at the University of Guelph, designed to manage
and disseminate DNA barcode records and standardize DNA barcoding efforts.

#### 2005

### Essential tool

**BOLD2** introduced functionality to support a global network of early adopters of DNA barcoding.
It was accompanied by a publication detailing its storage, management, and analytical capabilities.

#### 2007

### Barcode Index Number

**BOLD3** introduced the Barcode Index Number (BIN) system, which improved species identification
and analysis by organizing similar sequences into distinct clusters and registering them.

#### 2013

### Expanded Capabilities

**BOLD4** was released with advanced analysis tools, a revamped interface, and expanded marker
support.

#### 2016

### Global Collaboration and Innovation

**BOLD5** introduces a range of new capabilities, including a revamped data model, support for a
network of mirrors, new APIs, improved performance.

#### 2024

### Growth of Barcodes & Species on BOLD

Advancing biodiversity science through DNA-based species identification.

###### Welcome to BOLD Systems Version 5

# Identifying species through DNA barcodes

BOLDv5 features a completely redesigned layout compared to BOLDv4, with a focus on richer content
and supporting materials. It also includes a more complex site structure. Tutorials are being
developed to facilitate the transition. In the meantime, BOLDv4 remains accessible at
 [v4.boldsystems.org][25] 

[ Learn the Layout ][26]

and release.

###### Overview

## Process of identifying species via standardized DNA genetic markers.

##### **01.**
##### DNA Extraction:

The process begins with isolating DNA from the specimen. This step requires care to ensure that the
genetic material is free from contaminants and adequately preserved for subsequent analysis.

##### **02.**
##### PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction):

Using the extracted DNA, the PCR amplifies target gene regions, creating numerous copies to
facilitate detailed examination. This step is crucial for enhancing the visibility of genetic
markers necessary for identification.

##### **03.**
##### Sequencing:

The amplified DNA undergoes sequencing, where the order of nucleotides is determined. This sequence
represents the unique fingerprint of the species and is essential for accurate identification.

##### **04.**
##### Sequence Matching:

Finally, the obtained sequence is matched against reference libraries in BOLD. This comparison
allows for the identification of the specimen by finding the closest records.

### Through this method, unknown samples are identified to species present in the reference library.

[ Identify Now ][28]

###### Data

## Barcode Index Numbers (BINs)

The Barcode Index Number (BIN) system is an automated method for clustering DNA barcode sequences
from animals into operational taxonomic units that usually correspond to species. Each cluster is
assigned a unique identifier which serves as a proxy for a species, enabling researchers to examine
biodiversity patterns even in the absence of formal species descriptions.

By standardizing DNA-based species identification, the BIN system facilitates large-scale
biodiversity assessments, supports species discovery, and enhances ecological and conservation
efforts.

Each BIN is linked to a dedicated page that consolidates all available data for its members.

[ BIN Database ][29]

###### Data Dissemination

## Our Database Partners

Working with major biodiversity databasing initiatives, BOLD ensures interoperability and maximizes
access to DNA barcode data.

###### Timeline

## The History of BOLD

BOLD started as a database and analytical platform but has since expanded its role. With its rapidly
growing database, broad taxonomic coverage, and novel methods and functionalities, it has become a
key component of the biodiversity informatics landscape.

### Proof-of-concept

**BOLD** was launched as a proof-of-concept platform at the University of Guelph, designed to manage
and disseminate DNA barcode records and standardize DNA barcoding efforts.

#### 2005

### Essential tool

**BOLD2** introduced functionality to support a global network of early adopters of DNA barcoding.
It was accompanied by a publication detailing its storage, management, and analytical capabilities.

#### 2007

### Barcode Index Number

**BOLD3** introduced the Barcode Index Number (BIN) system, which improved species identification
and analysis by organizing similar sequences into distinct clusters and registering them.

#### 2013

### Expanded Capabilities

**BOLD4** was released with advanced analysis tools, a revamped interface, and expanded marker
support.

#### 2016

### Global Collaboration and Innovation

**BOLD5** introduces a range of new capabilities, including a revamped data model, support for a
network of mirrors, new APIs, improved performance.

#### 2024

### Growth of Barcodes & Species on BOLD

Advancing biodiversity science through DNA-based species identification.

courses are. Once you sign in, you will be able to access all the content in the class paid for.

the timetable that you can download and recreate as you like with your children as well. Find it on

Your card is automatically debited at the end of your current subscription except you stop the auto
renew. To do that go to classnotes.ng/my-account, select My Subscription and turn off the Auto Renew

### BIOINFORMATICS SERVICESStrain-Level Metagenomics

The CosmosID pipeline was developed to address many challenges in modern-day bioinformatics by
achieving better taxonomic resolution than traditional kmer and assembly-based approaches, yet
maintaining computational efficiency and being able to achieve species, sub-species and strain-level
resolution with less sequencing depth.
Multi-kingdom identification for every sample, every time
Precision filtering for confidence thresholds
fastQC results for data quality reporting
Exportable abundance values, charts & visualizations including sunburts, bubble charts & stacked bar
graphs
Unlimited comparative analysis software, complete with Heatmaps, 3D PCA, Alpha Diversity plots &
Beta Diversity PCoA
[LEARN MORE][43]
[LAUNCH APP][44]

### Sequencing Services

At CosmosID, we offer a range of sequencing services that cover a range of metagenomic approaches.
Our sequencing services cover a range of different sample types and have been extensively
researched.
Amplicon Sequencing

Like many metagenomic approaches, amplicon sequencing offers unique advantages to microbiome
researchers including cost-effectiveness and the creation of comprehensive taxonomic profiles.

Shallow Shotgun Sequencing

Shallow Shotgun Sequencing allows researchers to unlock the microbiome with better species level
resolution than 16S sequencing whilst also maintaining cost effectiveness. This makes it a powerful
choice for large cohort studies that focus on human health, such as the gut microbiome.

Deep Shotgun Sequencing

In deep shotgun sequencing, whole DNA is extracted from a sample then exposed to random
fragmentation prior to Next Generation Sequencing to gain an exponential amount of metagenomics data
and advantages alongside it.

Bacterial Isolate Sequencing

Whole Genome Sequencing of bacterial isolates offers unique advantages over traditional typing
methods. Unlike PCR, this technology identifies the complete genetic makeup of an organism and
offers unprecedented insight into the different types of microbial diversity .

[FIND OUT MORE][45]

Through unrivaled sensitivity and precision, the CosmosID metagenomics pipeline is validated to
return strain-level resolution of bacteria, viruses, phages, fungi, protists, bacterial MAGs as well

### Sequencing Services

At CosmosID, we offer a range of sequencing services that cover a range of metagenomic approaches.
Our sequencing services cover a range of different sample types and have been extensively
researched.
Amplicon Sequencing

Like many metagenomic approaches, amplicon sequencing offers unique advantages to microbiome
researchers including cost-effectiveness and the creation of comprehensive taxonomic profiles.

Shallow Shotgun Sequencing

Shallow Shotgun Sequencing allows researchers to unlock the microbiome with better species level
resolution than 16S sequencing whilst also maintaining cost effectiveness. This makes it a powerful
choice for large cohort studies that focus on human health, such as the gut microbiome.

Deep Shotgun Sequencing

In deep shotgun sequencing, whole DNA is extracted from a sample then exposed to random
fragmentation prior to Next Generation Sequencing to gain an exponential amount of metagenomics data
and advantages alongside it.

Bacterial Isolate Sequencing

Whole Genome Sequencing of bacterial isolates offers unique advantages over traditional typing
methods. Unlike PCR, this technology identifies the complete genetic makeup of an organism and
offers unprecedented insight into the different types of microbial diversity .

## Welcome

GenHunter has innovative products & services for our patented AP-TAG ligand-receptor identification
& Differential Display gene expression analysis. We also have Antibodies/Cytokines, an extensive
Western Blotting line, Cell Culture products, RNA & PCR cloning products, a Sanger DNA Sequencing
Service, & other Lab Equipment.

Our Western Blotting products offers a streamlined experience for Westerns, helping to get the best
results while saving money on antibodies and other consumables. Products include the popular
PerfectWestern containers (now available in 38 different sizes with multiple colors), The
PerfectMembrane, PerfectFilm, PerfectWaver, PerfectRocker, orbital shakers, and PerfectPipettors.

We continue to serve the biomedical & life science research community in the fields of Cell Biology,
Molecular Biology, Immunology, Neuroscience, Drug Development, etc.

# ДНК-тесты и генетические исследования любой сложности

Молекулярно-генетическая лаборатория «Геноаналитика» представляет собой многофункциональный центр,
предлагающий разнообразные услуги как для врачей и пациентов, так и для проведения научных
исследований. Мы обеспечиваем индивидуальный подход к каждому, предоставляя уникальные решения для
диагностики.

Мы предлагаем пациентам широкий выбор генетических исследований: исследование полного [генома][125]
и [экзома][126], [секвенирование экзомных панелей][127], собственная разработка — неинвазивный
скрининг [«ДОТ-тест»][128], исследование на [совместимость пары][129], [консультации
специалистов][130], а также многое другое. Для пациентов, проходящих исследование в нашей
лаборатории, действует программа лояльности при подтверждении результатов методом [Сэнгера][131], а
также бесплатная выдача сырых данных. В нашей лаборатории здоровые люди могут пройти [исследования
для оценки риска развития наследственных заболеваний][132]. Вам доступна удобная оплата в рассрочку
без обращения в банк и возможность оплаты исследований за счёт средств благотворительного фонда. Мы
стремимся сделать медицинские услуги доступными и комфортными для всех, обеспечивая высокое качество
обслуживания и поддержку на каждом этапе.

Врачи получают точную информацию для корректной постановки диагноза и назначения наиболее
эффективной терапии. Кроме того, специалисты других специализаций могут получить бесплатную
консультацию генетика в сложных клинических случаях, а также доступ к бесплатным обучающим
материалам и курсам. Таким образом, интеграция генетических данных в клиническую практику улучшает
результаты лечения, а также способствует более ранней диагностике и профилактике.

Наша лаборатория предоставляет [ученым услуги для решения научных задач][133]: полногеномное
секвенирование с различными вариантами покрытия (30×, 50×, 100×), анализ транскриптома, метагеномный
и эпигенетический анализ, а также многое другое. Наши решения в области секвенирования и
[высококачественные реактивы][134] помогут вам на каждой фазе научного эксперимента.

Мы рады предложить персонализированные решения, соответствующие именно вашим потребностям.

## О лаборатории и ее преимуществах:

Молекулярно-генетическая лаборатория «Геноаналитика» была основана в 2007 году группой выдающихся
учёных из учреждений РАН, в том числе академиком и главой проекта по расшифровке восьмого генома
человека в мире — Константином Георгиевичем Скрябиным, и стала одним из лидеров прикладного
генетического направления российской биотех-индустрии.

**Наши специалисты** — профессора, доктора и кандидаты наук, опытные врачи и талантливые выпускники
ведущих вузов России, обладающие уникальными знаниями и опытом, позволяющими проводить
NGS-исследования любой степени сложности.

Компания «Геноаналитика» обладает **патентами на ряд уникальных разработок**: технологию определения
трисомии хромосом методом секвенирования, патентом на способ неинвазивной пренатальной диагностики
анеуплоидий плода, а также патентом на способ селективного отбора целевых участков ДНК.

Мы стремимся обеспечить доступность наших предложений, вне зависимости от географического положения,
и гордимся тем, что можем оказать помощь каждому, кто нуждается в наших услугах.

# ДНК-тесты и генетические исследования любой сложности

Молекулярно-генетическая лаборатория «Геноаналитика» представляет собой многофункциональный центр,
предлагающий разнообразные услуги как для врачей и пациентов, так и для проведения научных
исследований. Мы обеспечиваем индивидуальный подход к каждому, предоставляя уникальные решения для
диагностики.

Мы предлагаем пациентам широкий выбор генетических исследований: исследование полного [генома][125]
и [экзома][126], [секвенирование экзомных панелей][127], собственная разработка — неинвазивный
скрининг [«ДОТ-тест»][128], исследование на [совместимость пары][129], [консультации
специалистов][130], а также многое другое. Для пациентов, проходящих исследование в нашей
лаборатории, действует программа лояльности при подтверждении результатов методом [Сэнгера][131], а
также бесплатная выдача сырых данных. В нашей лаборатории здоровые люди могут пройти [исследования
для оценки риска развития наследственных заболеваний][132]. Вам доступна удобная оплата в рассрочку
без обращения в банк и возможность оплаты исследований за счёт средств благотворительного фонда. Мы
стремимся сделать медицинские услуги доступными и комфортными для всех, обеспечивая высокое качество
обслуживания и поддержку на каждом этапе.

Врачи получают точную информацию для корректной постановки диагноза и назначения наиболее
эффективной терапии. Кроме того, специалисты других специализаций могут получить бесплатную
консультацию генетика в сложных клинических случаях, а также доступ к бесплатным обучающим
материалам и курсам. Таким образом, интеграция генетических данных в клиническую практику улучшает
результаты лечения, а также способствует более ранней диагностике и профилактике.

Наша лаборатория предоставляет [ученым услуги для решения научных задач][133]: полногеномное
секвенирование с различными вариантами покрытия (30×, 50×, 100×), анализ транскриптома, метагеномный
и эпигенетический анализ, а также многое другое. Наши решения в области секвенирования и
[высококачественные реактивы][134] помогут вам на каждой фазе научного эксперимента.

Мы рады предложить персонализированные решения, соответствующие именно вашим потребностям.

## О лаборатории и ее преимуществах:

Молекулярно-генетическая лаборатория «Геноаналитика» была основана в 2007 году группой выдающихся
учёных из учреждений РАН, в том числе академиком и главой проекта по расшифровке восьмого генома
человека в мире — Константином Георгиевичем Скрябиным, и стала одним из лидеров прикладного
генетического направления российской биотех-индустрии.

**Наши специалисты** — профессора, доктора и кандидаты наук, опытные врачи и талантливые выпускники
ведущих вузов России, обладающие уникальными знаниями и опытом, позволяющими проводить
NGS-исследования любой степени сложности.

Компания «Геноаналитика» обладает **патентами на ряд уникальных разработок**: технологию определения
трисомии хромосом методом секвенирования, патентом на способ неинвазивной пренатальной диагностики
анеуплоидий плода, а также патентом на способ селективного отбора целевых участков ДНК.

Мы стремимся обеспечить доступность наших предложений, вне зависимости от географического положения,
и гордимся тем, что можем оказать помощь каждому, кто нуждается в наших услугах.

# Immune Repertoire Insights That Advance Precision Medicine

Unveil the adaptive immune response with TCR/BCR profiling and single-cell paired-chain V(D)J
analysis for biomarker discovery and therapeutic development

[ Discover Our Story ][64]

## Resolve patient-specific immune signals for cancer, autoimmunity, infectious disease, and more.

Immune repertoire sequencing provides insights into immune history and diversity, neutralizing
antibodies, antigen specificity, and clonal dynamics with the potential to transform overall
management of immune-mediated diseases and therapies.

Standard immune repertoire sequencing approaches are limited by subtype restrictions, lack of
reproducibility, high error rates, insufficient capture of rare clones, and limited data analysis
tools for mapping repertoire diversity and clonality networks.

See why iRepertoire is the most trusted and comprehensive source for immune enlightenment.

[ Explore Our Technology ][65]

## Full-stack immune profiling expertise:
## From sensitive detection to rich data analysis

We offer a complete suite of adaptive immune receptor profiling and data analysis solutions. Each
platform workflow combines proprietary chemistry with optimized analytics to reveal the true
diversity of the adaptive immune system.

[Bulk TCR/BCR Sequencing with Full 7-Chain Coverage]

## Bulk TCR/BCR Sequencing with Full 7-Chain Coverage

While other platforms require multiple reactions to profile different receptor chains or limit
analysis to DNA or RNA alone, iRepertoire’s dam-PCR technology simultaneously amplifies all seven
chains (TCR⍺, TCRβ, TCR𝛾, TCRδ, IgH, IgK, IgL) with UMI-based error correction. The unique
capability delivers the complete immune picture your research demands, without compromising on
sensitivity or amplification bias.

[ Explore Bulk Repertoire Sequencing ][66]
[Single-Cell V(D)J Sequencing]

## Single-Cell V(D)J Sequencing

Capture therapeutically relevant cognate TCR or BCR pairing from FACS-isolated single cells with our
iPair platform, designed for researchers who need full-length, physically paired sequences without
investing in expensive single-cell platforms.

## Precise, cost-effective insights with published validity
## across key clinical areas

Our immune repertoire profiling solutions empower discovery, preclinical, and clinical teams across
therapeutic areas. See how we enable confident biomarker identification and therapeutic development
for each.

### Immuno-oncology Therapy Monitoring

Comprehensive TCR/ BCR repertoire and gene expression insights to track treatment response, reveal
biomarkers of efficacy or toxicity, and support data-driven clinical decisions.

### Cell Therapy Optimization

Cell therapy optimization and quality control with multi-omic immune profiling that validates
manufacturing consistency, confirms therapeutic phenotype, and de-risks clinical development.

### Infectious Disease Therapeutics

Advance infectious disease therapeutics by mapping rare antigen-specific B- and T-cell responses,
defining host immune signatures, and guiding the discovery of vaccines and monoclonal antibodies.

### Autoimmune Disease Biomarker Discovery

Uncover autoimmune disease biomarkers by profiling rare B and T-cell clones and immune
repertoires-delivering reproducible insights into disease mechanisms, diagnostics, and treatment
response prediction.

### Vaccine Monitoring

Precisely quantify vaccine-induced TCR/BCR responses with ultra-sensitive bulk and single-cell
profiling. Detect rare antigen-specific clonotypes and evaluate vaccine efficacy across
infectious-disease and cancer programs with RepSeq+ and iPair. 

### Transplant Immunology

Precisely track alloreactive TCR/BCR responses to evaluate graft compatibility, rejection risk, and
post-transplant immune recovery. Detect early clonal expansions and monitor long-term immune
stability with ultra-sensitive bulk and single-cell profiling powered by RepSeq+ and iPair.

forgotten that behind every sample is a scientific question that matters. Our technology is

* Collaborative data interpretation and publication support

* Validation documentation ready for regulatory submissions

## Flexibility That Accelerates Discovery
* Adapt protocols mid-study as your questions evolve
* Scale from pilot studies to pivotal trials seamlessly
* Support for non-standard sample types and experimental designs

iRepertoire has been the scientists’ choice for immune repertoire analysis, offering accuracy,
reproducibility, and actionable insights. We have partnered with top institutions to develop the

[Bulk TCR/BCR Sequencing with Full 7-Chain Coverage]

### Bulk TCR/BCR Sequencing with Full 7-Chain Coverage

While other platforms require multiple reactions to profile different receptor chains or limit
analysis to DNA or RNA alone, iRepertoire’s dam-PCR technology simultaneously amplifies all seven
chains (TCRa, TCRB, TCRy, TCR6, IgH, IgK, IgL) with UMI- based error correction. The unique
capability delivers the complete immune picture your research demands, without compromising on
sensitivity or amplification bias.

[ Explore Bulk Repertoire Sequencing ][69]
[Single-Cell V(D)J Sequencing]

### Single-Cell V(D)J Sequencing

Capture therapeutically relevant cognate TCR or BCR pairing from FACS-isolated single cells with our
iPair platform, designed for researchers who need full-length, physically paired sequences without
investing in expensive single-cell platforms.

[ Discover Single-Cell V(D)J Analysis ][70]
[Bioinformatics, B cell network plot]

### Bioinformatics

We’ve analyzed immune repertoires since 2009, publishing landmark studies and supporting dozens of
clinical programs. Our scientists don’t just generate data; they partner with you to extract
biological meaning and accelerate decision-making.

[ See Our Advanced Data Analytics ][71]

## Precise, cost-effective insights with published validity
## across key clinical areas

Our immune repertoire profiling solutions empower discovery, preclinical, and clinical teams across
therapeutic areas. See how we enable confident biomarker identification and therapeutic development
for each.

### Immuno-oncology Therapy Monitoring

Comprehensive TCR/ BCR repertoire and gene expression insights to track treatment response, reveal
biomarkers of efficacy or toxicity, and support data-driven clinical decisions.

### Cell Therapy Optimization

Cell therapy optimization and quality control with multi-omic immune profiling that validates
manufacturing consistency, confirms therapeutic phenotype, and de-risks clinical development.

### Infectious Disease Therapeutics

Advance infectious disease therapeutics by mapping rare antigen-specific B- and T-cell responses,
defining host immune signatures, and guiding the discovery of vaccines and monoclonal antibodies.

### Autoimmune Disease Biomarker Discovery

Uncover autoimmune disease biomarkers by profiling rare B and T-cell clones and immune
repertoires-delivering reproducible insights into disease mechanisms, diagnostics, and treatment
response prediction.

### Vaccine Monitoring

Precisely quantify vaccine-induced TCR/BCR responses with ultra-sensitive bulk and single-cell
profiling. Detect rare antigen-specific clonotypes and evaluate vaccine efficacy across
infectious-disease and cancer programs with RepSeq+ and iPair. 

### Transplant Immunology

Precisely track alloreactive TCR/BCR responses to evaluate graft compatibility, rejection risk, and
post-transplant immune recovery. Detect early clonal expansions and monitor long-term immune
stability with ultra-sensitive bulk and single-cell profiling powered by RepSeq+ and iPair. 

## The iRepertoire difference

Founded by immunologists for immunologists at HudsonAlpha Institute for Biotechnology, we’ve never
forgotten that behind every sample is a scientific question that matters. Our technology is
sophisticated, but our approach is simple: deliver the most complete, accurate immune profiling data
possible, and partner with you to extract biological meaning. Our three main core values set us
apart from other companies as we strive to create true partnerships with our customers.

## Scientific Partnership, Not Just Service
* Dedicated PhD-level scientists review every project from library prep through data delivery
* Custom assay optimization for your specific research questions
* Collaborative data interpretation and publication support

## Quality You Can Defend
* GCLP-compliant Quality Management System
* Batch-level QC with contamination detection and flagging
* Replicate controls in every run for absolute confidence
* Validation documentation ready for regulatory submissions

## Flexibility That Accelerates Discovery
* Adapt protocols mid-study as your questions evolve
* Scale from pilot studies to pivotal trials seamlessly
* Support for non-standard sample types and experimental designs

iRepertoire has been the scientists’ choice for immune repertoire analysis, offering accuracy,
reproducibility, and actionable insights. We have partnered with top institutions to develop the
next generation of immune-based biomarkers and therapeutics. Explore who our partners are or read
our publications to learn more about our contributions.

# Welcome to Microbe Notes

[Microbe Notes Cover]

**Microbe Notes **is an educational platform covering study notes on microbiology, bacteriology,
virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational
biology, laboratory, health, medical, and related branches of the life sciences. It was established
on 2018-07-20. It provides structured study notes and concept-focused explanations designed to
support undergraduate and graduate students, with particular usefulness for exam preparation in
A-level Biology, AP Biology, IB Biology, and university-level biology and microbiology programs
(BSc, MSc, MPhil, and PhD).

   [Calculus][112]" [ourbigbook.com/go/topic/fundamental-theorem-of-calculus][113]

# Punnett Square Calculator

Predict genetic combinations with precision. Support for monohybrid to pentahybrid crosses with
detailed phenotypic and genotypic analysis.

## What is a Punnett Square Calculator?

A Punnett Square is a powerful genetic diagram used to predict the probability of offspring
inheriting specific traits from their parents. Named after British geneticist Reginald Punnett, this
tool helps visualize all possible genetic combinations in a cross.

Our calculator supports monohybrid (single gene), dihybrid (two genes), trihybrid (three genes),
tetrahybrid (four genes), and pentahybrid (five genes) crosses, making it perfect for students,
teachers, researchers, and genetics enthusiasts.

**Key Features:**
* Automatic genotype and phenotype calculation
* Visual color-coded results
* Genetic ratio analysis
* Downloadable results in JPEG format

## How to Use the Punnett Square Generator

**Step 1: Select Cross Type**
Choose from Monohybrid (1 gene pair) to Pentahybrid (5 gene pairs) depending on how many traits
you're analyzing.

**Step 2: Enter Parent Genotypes**
Input the genetic makeup of both parents using allele notation. Use uppercase letters for dominant
alleles (A, B) and lowercase for recessive alleles (a, b). Example: AaBb represents heterozygous for
two traits.

**Step 3: Choose Display Options**

## Our Ordering Process

Simplicity and speed are hallmarks of SeqCenter’s business model. Our entire ordering process from
quote generation through checkout can be completed online in a few minutes. However, if you need
assistance, we’re always here to help.

### Obtain a Quote or Place an Order

Fill out our easy-to-use form, receive your quote, and finalize your order.

### Submit Your Samples

Follow our simple directions and ship your samples to our Pittsburgh address.

### Receive Your Data

Within 14 days – most times even less than that – we’ll upload your data to a personal folder for
you to access.

sequencing and analysis pipelines focus on guaranteed rapid turnaround (≤2 weeks) and sample input
flexibility.

Our human genomics workflows prioritize sensitivity, reproducibility, and data integrity, supporting
both research and translational applications. From cohort-scale sequencing to targeted studies, we
deliver high-depth, high-confidence data for variant detection and gene expression analysis.
Rigorous QC, rapid turnaround, and flexible project design ensure your study progresses efficiently
while meeting the highest scientific standards.

SeqCenter has been delivering genomics at scale since 2019. Founded by evolutionary biologists, our
sequencing and analysis pipelines focus on guaranteed rapid turnaround (≤2 weeks) and sample input

diversity. Our workflows are built to provide robust metagenomic and amplicon sequencing solutions
that deliver accurate taxonomic and functional insights across diverse ecosystems. Whether profiling
microbial communities or exploring ecosystem dynamics, our scalable pipelines enable rapid, reliable
data generation from even the most heterogeneous samples.

quote generation through checkout can be completed online in a few minutes. However, if you need

Select Page
Technelysium has supplied software for DNA sequencing and analysis since the popular Chromas program
was first released in 1996. Our software is intended for projects which do not require large
software packages costing thousands of dollars. We have two products:
* [Chromas][7] is a free, simple, easy-to-use viewer and editor for chromatograms (traces) from

# Encontramos tu laboratorio para solicitar Test Genéticos.

Si eres un particular, médico o investigador filtramos y enviamos tu petición de cualquier prueba
genética a laboratorios especializados para que la estudien y te contacten en caso de poder
ayudarte. Encuentra el mejor asesoramiento, compara tarifas y revisa nuestras evaluaciones de
anteriores pacientes y profesionales para poder seleccionar tu mejor opción.

Search for:
* [Test genéticos más buscados][7]
* [Filtra por categorías clínicas][8]

### Cómo funciona

#### Selecciona tu test o servicio genético
#### Busca en nuestra web el test o servicio del que te gustaría obtener asesoramiento y precios
#### para poder comparar laboratorios genéticos.

#### Rellena nuestro formulario
#### Nuestro formulario es gratuito y sin compromiso. No olvides añadir la mayor información posible
#### sobre tu caso particular.

#### ¡Tu solicitud está en camino!
#### Test genéticos filtra y envía tu solicitud únicamente a aquellos laboratorios que pueden dar
#### solución a tu petición para que puedan contactar contigo.

#### ¡Enhorabuena ya tenemos tu informe!
#### Recibe en tu mail en 24-48hrs un listado con los datos de contacto de todos los laboratorios

profile, providing more and better answers to help solve the most complex mysteries. Take your
forensic investigations further with our comprehensive portfolio of next-generation sequencing (NGS)
solutions.

[ Learn More ][40]

We enable a range of capabilities that allow you to make the identifications you seek. Providing
modern alternatives to traditional methods, we provide you with everything you need to enhance your
operations today and equip you for the analyses of tomorrow. Our comprehensive NGS workflow supports
multiple applications and is easy to learn, scalable, and integrates seamlessly into your existing
laboratory environment.

# Go beyond the traditional DNA profile

Welcome to the next era of human identification discoveries. We go beyond the traditional DNA
profile, providing more and better answers to help solve the most complex mysteries. Take your
forensic investigations further with our comprehensive portfolio of next-generation sequencing (NGS)
solutions.

[ Learn More ][40]

## Future-proof your laboratory

We enable a range of capabilities that allow you to make the identifications you seek. Providing
modern alternatives to traditional methods, we provide you with everything you need to enhance your
operations today and equip you for the analyses of tomorrow. Our comprehensive NGS workflow supports
multiple applications and is easy to learn, scalable, and integrates seamlessly into your existing
laboratory environment.

[ Explore capabilities ][41]

### Short tandem repeats

Unlock the real power of short tandem repeats (STRs).

### Mitochondrial DNA

Rescue even the most challenging, compromised, or degraded DNA samples using mtDNA analysis.

### Kinship

Explore a complete kinship continuum from forensic genetic genealogy to paternity.

### Externally visible characteristics

Reduce the number of leads you need to follow by generating physical descriptions from DNA.

## Solutions to empower your laboratory

We provide the highest quality, fully integrated sequencing solutions. Our comprehensive product
portfolio includes everything you need for each step in your workflow—from library preparation to
sequencing to data analysis. And beyond.

Prepare Sequence Analyze Service & Support

### Library prep made simple

Our ForenSeq workflow makes the library prep process simple and seamless for both mitochondrial and
nuclear DNA libraries, regardless of your level of experience.

[ See All Library Prep ][42]

### Flexible sequencing for all human identification studies

The MiSeq FGx Sequencing System is the NDIS-approved NGS system designed specifically for research,
forensic, and human identification use.

[ See All Sequencing ][43]

### Simple data analysis for all user levels

Our Universal Analysis Software is designed to empower new-to-NGS and experienced users alike.
Application-specific modules offer a streamlined experience and make data management and high-volume
analysis simple for a range of analyses.

[ See All Analysis ][44]

### Expert support for every step

No matter what you need, our expert team is here to help. We provide superior support across the
entire Verogen workflow and offer comprehensive service coverage for your equipment and software. In
addition, our team offers validation plans and implementation guidance, so you can quickly get your
NGS workflows up and running.

[ See All Services & Support ][45]

## Our mission: to help you find better answers, sooner

Verogen was founded on the belief that it is time for better answers to forensic and human
identification questions. We are committed to providing high-quality solutions with leading-edge
technology to help you solve even the most complex problems. We are devoted to finding better ways
to equip you to discover more meaningful answers than ever before.
